description: Request body exceeds the deployment's 2 MB size limit (final-review-server.md I-2; value raised from 256 KB in final-fix-server-review.md N-1) -- rejected by the ASGI body-size middleware before the body is even fully read, let alone JSON-parsed or schema-validated.

setup.note: request Content-Length (or, absent that, the actual bytes read off the wire) exceeds 2 MB -- no component/component_version rows are created; the deployment's own per-field/per-array caps (components/locales/slug/etc.) are a separate, additional layer, not a substitute for this one

error.message: Request body exceeds the maximum allowed size.
